title: The Siang dam and a threatened homeland

ai.summary: The Siang dam project in Arunachal Pradesh faces opposition from local communities who fear it threatens their homeland, with police setting up barriers to restrict access to the Siang river.

facts.claim: The Siang dam project in Arunachal Pradesh faces opposition from local communities who fear it threatens their homeland
facts.quote: A few kilometres from the entrance to Arunachal Pradesh’s Parong village, an unpaved road winds all the way down to the Siang river.

facts.claim: police setting up barriers to restrict access to the Siang river
facts.quote: At dusk, all that is visible at the beginning of the dirt road is the glint of freshly painted yellow barricades of the State police and the shine from the silver of the concertina wires that connect the barricades.

facts.claim: Central security forces who guard the check post here have two purposes — to respond to “unrest” and to stop anyone without “clearance” from proceeding to Siang’s waters
facts.quote: The Central security forces who guard the check post here have two purposes — to respond to “unrest” and to stop anyone without “clearance” from proceeding to Siang’s waters.

ai.background_note: The Siang Indigenous Farmers' Forum opposes a proposed mega dam on the Siang in Arunachal Pradesh, which has led to detentions and ongoing protests.
